name: Feature amplification
summary: A method that changes a photograph to raise the response of one network layer, so the network patterns grow out of the image.
how: Pick one layer of a trained image network; a middle layer gives eyes and fur, a high layer gives whole animals.
Change the pixels of the image by small steps so that the layer response rises.
Repeat at 4 to 8 image sizes (octaves) and mix the results back into one image.
Feed the output back in and zoom 3% for each frame to make an endless loop.

origin.note: Alexander Mordvintsev and colleagues post the method and its first images in a Google research blog in June 2015.

adoptions.via: Google releases the code in July 2015; users post dog-face and eye-filled photographs on web forums and image boards.
